verdict.rationale: Missive has a built-in AI assistant that runs long sessions with visible activity, creates drafts, answers how-to questions from the docs, and can call MCP tools. Its first-party MCP server also lets Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts from natural-language prompts like "summarize your inbox and draft replies." missing for 10: detailed docs on which in-app actions (archive, assign, label, snooze) the assistant can perform by natural-language command, independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-app use without supplying your own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key.
